items.text: Conclusion rewritten from old 13-section plan format into canonical research conclusion format (Research Question, Summary, Methodology, Findings, Limitations, Actions). All substantive content preserved; system contracts and exhaustive action inventory retained as dedicated sections.

4 concrete actions defined for P1 and P2 gaps (per round 2 d2=A): (1) Add git_commit_hash to LPBS download_artifacts [P1, fix, S], (2) Add post-publish version sync callback [P1, execute, M], (3) Add rollback API [P2, execute, M], (4) Add LPBS publish webhook [P2, execute, M].

This research appears ready for conclusion. All 5 audit questions are answered with evidence, system contracts are formalized, gaps are cataloged with prioritized recommendations, and the conclusion stands alone as a reference document. Consider reviewing and processing.

items.topic: Should P3/P4 gaps also become backlog items?
items.context: Round 2 d2=A created items for P1 and P2 gaps. Three lower-priority gaps remain: P3 approval→deploy automation (S effort), P3 LPBS_SERVICE_SECRET validation (S effort), P4 entitlement↔approval documentation fix (XS effort). These are documented in the conclusion but not yet actionable backlog items.

options.label: Yes, create items for P3 and P4 gaps too
options.rationale: Captures all identified work so nothing is lost. Low effort to create the items; they can sit in backlog until prioritized.

options.label: No, leave as recommendations in the conclusion
options.rationale: P3/P4 items are low priority and may never be worth doing. Cluttering the backlog with low-priority items creates noise.

items.topic: Should the P1/P2 backlog items be created now via CLI?
items.context: The conclusion defines 4 actions (P1 and P2 gaps) as 'Create backlog item' actions. These can either be created immediately via swarm-manager CLI as part of processing this research item, or left for manual creation later.

options.label: Yes, create them now when this item is processed
options.rationale: Ensures the items exist in the backlog immediately and are not forgotten. The action descriptions have enough detail for creation.

options.label: No, defer to initiative planning
options.rationale: The initiative owner should decide timing and exact scope. Creating them now might not match the initiative's current focus.
